description: THE MOAT's front page for global business: the stories its editors selected for an edition, in page order, each with author, publication, language, country, a direct link to the original reporting and why THE MOAT selected it. Use it for "what matters in global business today" or for a given day. Returns references and links, never article text.

date.description: Brussels date of the edition (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for the current edition.

include_related.description: Also return other publications' versions and follow-up developments of each story.

language.description: Language of THE MOAT's own text in the response. V1: English. Sources keep their original language.

name: daily_brief

items.description: A story on THE MOAT's front page: the lead version, other publications' versions and follow-up developments.
One piece of original work, as a reference: credit, link and metadata. Never the work itself.

author.description: The author as the publisher credits them; null if the publisher gives no person's name.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the publication's principal editorial market; "EU" or "INT" for European or international bodies and channels.

english_available.description: Whether the publication publishes in English.

label.description: THE MOAT's own short label for the story, written by an editor, if any.

language.description: Language of the original work (BCP 47, e.g. "en", "fr").

publication.description: The publication (for video and podcasts, the channel or programme).

published_at.description: When the publisher published it (ISO 8601), as the publisher states.

reader_access.description: Whether readers can open the original freely.

rights.description: What THE MOAT may do with this work. link_only: reference and link only.

role.description: lead: the version THE MOAT leads with; also: another publication's version of the same news; development: a separate follow-up.

title.description: The publisher's exact headline, as a citation. Null when withheld by THE MOAT's rights policy. Never translated.

title_use.description: How the title may be used: as a citation of the original, or not at all.

translation_permitted.description: False unless a licence or primary-source status allows it. Do not translate or paraphrase link_only work at length.

url.description: Direct link to the original work. Always cite and link this.
